Pulse for 5 November 2026

The stories from 5 November 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

AI agents

Agents keep the work going

Teammates are a set of personal agents in Perplexity that take on work lasting longer than one chat, while you inspect the results and guide what happens next.

Everyday tool

Talk to Muse out loud

Muse Realtime Voice is a way to talk out loud with Meta's Muse app, with a face you can hide, keep beside the chat, or fill the screen.

Everyday tool

Claude reads your spending

Personal Finance in Claude is a way to connect bank and card accounts and ask about your money in ordinary language, and Anthropic says the link is read-only.

New model

AI finds bugs for defenders

GPT-6 Cyber is a cybersecurity model from OpenAI that finds and checks exploitable flaws while staying inside a scope a researcher sets, and the post does not offer it as a public chat feature.

New model

Try a new coding model

Inkling 2 Small is a coding model from Thinking Machines Lab that you can try in the browser, built to stay on a long job and look at pictures while the weights stay closed.

Everyday tool

Gemini videos last longer

Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is a video model from Google that is now generally available, and a clip can run up to 15 seconds instead of the 10 seconds on Omni 1.1.

New model

Try an open coding model

Ripple-65B Preview is a general-purpose model with open weights from Ricursive Intelligence, a public variant of the model the company says powers its chip-design work, and Ricursive lists hosts where you can try it.

New model

ERNIE base model skips EU

ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base is a base model, the raw checkpoint at the end of pre-training, which Baidu published on 5 November 2026 under a license that excludes the EU.

Everyday tool

Buy work agents in Claude

Claude Marketplace is a catalog of partner agents and products inside Claude, and Anthropic says eligible enterprise customers can put part of a committed spend toward new listings for security, software delivery, creative work, and everyday tasks.
